facts.fact: 严夫人接连撑开第二、第三把伞，每把伞里各藏一只鬼；血衣女鬼挤作一堆，提防着这老妇
facts.anchor: Madam Yau opened the second umbrella. Then the third. Each housed another ghost. They were like strays, huddled together in their bloody robes, wary of the older woman.

facts.fact: 锦玲从藏身处跃出，持钱剑、掷符，黄符触到鬼身即燃
facts.anchor: She leapt forward from her hiding position, coin sword in hand, flinging fu talismans towards the malevolent spirits, the yellow slips burning on contact.

facts.fact: 她挺剑打落严夫人手里最后一把伞，随即转身要斩最近那只厉鬼的头
facts.anchor: She thrust her sword forward, knocking the last umbrella from the madam’s hands, then pivoted to sever the head of the closest vengeful ghost.

facts.fact: 严夫人徒手攥住剑尖止住杀招，皮肤碰到祝圣铜钱冒起黑烟，她却毫不退缩
facts.anchor: Madam Yau’s fist closed over the tip of the sword, stopping the killing blow. Black smoke rose from where her skin touched the blessed coins, but she did not flinch.

facts.fact: 严夫人喝问“你以为你在干什么”，一道闪电劈到锦玲脚边，意在吓她
facts.anchor: “What do you think you are doing?” A bolt of lightning zigzagged down to the ground near Kiamling’s foot. An attempt to intimidate her.

facts.fact: 符只轻轻碰到，她额头与一只眼便烫成粉红；闪电随即在锦玲四周落成临时囚笼
facts.anchor: Pink and raw like she had thrust her face into a fire. The lightning crackled all at once, striking down around Kiamling in a makeshift cage.

facts.fact: 锦玲道破她也是妖鬼，她回“你这才看出来”，双眼一闪转绿，像夜里偷食泔水的狐狸
facts.anchor: “Took you long enough.” Madam Yau refused to give her any quarter. Her eyes flickered green for a moment, like a fox caught raiding the midden at night.

facts.fact: 锦玲认出她是狐精（wulei jing），想起几个月前把醉酒的兰开斯特一路引去僵尸队列的那只狐灵
facts.anchor: “A wulei jing.” Kiamling recalled the fox spirit who had led the drunken Lancaster in a merry chase into the geongsi column months back.

facts.fact: 伞下这些鬼不过是受惊的女人；严夫人说她答应过锦玲的祖母要护着她们
facts.anchor: They did not look much like the vengeful spirits Kiamling had heard of. Nothing more than terrified women. “The only thing is… I made a promise to your grandmother that I would protect them.”

facts.fact: 严夫人明说这套安排是锦玲祖母一手组织的，不只是知情
facts.anchor: It sounded like the brothel owner was claiming that Por Por not only knew about this, but had actually organised the arrangement. “Your Por Por organised this arrangement.”

facts.fact: 锦玲判断这是编不出来的谎，收剑要她把底细说清
facts.anchor: It was too much of a reach to be a story she had invented. She sheathed her sword. “I think you’d better fill me in.”

facts.fact: 楼上由女鬼接客，专从会伤人的男人身上多吸气，让他回家虚弱得抬不起手再害人
facts.anchor: Upstairs, the lui gwei provide the services of the bedchamber. They drink the most from people like him, who would cause harm. Better to send him home weak and unable to lift a finger against anyone else.

facts.fact: 严夫人反问会不会因为老虎要活就杀虎；锦玲驳“她们是鬼，根本不算活”
facts.anchor: Someone could fall sick tomorrow, or be gored by a tiger. Would you kill the tiger for wanting to live?” “They are ghosts. They don’t live!

facts.fact: 严夫人说区家是钟魁妹妹一脉的后人，钟魁本人无后而终；反问她为何连这名字都不知道
facts.anchor: “The Au family are descendants of her line. Not Chung Kwai, who died before he had offspring of his own, but his little sister. So why do you not know her name?”

facts.fact: 这位无名妹妹是第一位凡人妖鬼猎手，下十八层地狱为钟魁之死讨报；正因她的行动，钟魁才被抬为鬼王
facts.anchor: This unnamed sister was the first mortal yiugwai hunter. She crossed into the eighteen levels of hell to demand retribution for Chung Kwai’s death. It was her actions that elevated him to become King of Ghosts

facts.fact: 她只以美貌与婚姻留名；严夫人嘶声说饿鬼长针孔细嘴，是因为男人不愿看见女人的牙
facts.anchor: And what is she known for? Her beauty and her marriage.” Madam Yau hissed. “Why do you think hungry ghosts have needle mouths? Because men do not want to see our teeth.
